audit.why: Irelia owns 1-2, 3 and 4-5 are skill windows, she edges 6 on the cleaner all-in, Yi flips at first item and dominates at 2+. Full phases[].side and content win[] agree row-for-row and match the packet chart, including the unusual dip back to Irelia at level 6.
Four spikes correctly placed, and breakdown.spikes names both her level 6 and first-item timings against Yi's on-hit spike.
audit.corrected: Flawless Duet 16s/10s and Defiant Dance 20s added so 'wait for her E' is countable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanical errors and one omission. (a) dosFull[2] and dontsFull[1] both say Defiant Dance heals her; Riot's text gives it damage reduction while charging and a bigger strike on release — the heal in her kit is Bladesurge, which is also what makes anti-heal correct here, so the right buy was being justified by the wrong ability. (b) Nothing states that Flawless Duet's stun cancels Meditate, while the entry repeatedly tells the player to sustain through her poke. (c) Highlander's slow immunity versus the Vanguard's Edge wall slow is never mentioned.
audit.why: Bladesurge heals on every reset, so Grievous Wounds applied before the extended fight is what stops her refilling — that is the real case for Executioner's, not Defiant Dance. Meditate being cancelled by her E means the sustain plan only works with her E on cooldown. And the R wall's slow is exactly what Highlander ignores, which is a free reason to commit through it.
audit.corrected: Defiant Dance restated correctly in dosFull[2] and dontsFull[1]; Meditate cancellation written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5] and spikes[1]; Bladesurge healing and Grievous Wounds into spikes[2] and whys[5]; the slow immunity into report[5].

edits.before: Track her E — Flawless Duet (the second blade stun). It's the only tool that locks me down after I land from Alpha Strike; if it's on cooldown, my all-in window is open. Also watch Defiant Dance (W) before dumping Q burst into her.
edits.after: Track her E — Flawless Duet, 16s at rank 1 and 10s maxed. It is the only tool that locks me down after I land from Alpha Strike, and it cancels Meditate outright; with it down my all-in window is open. Also watch Defiant Dance (W, 20s).

edits.before: Bramble Vest or Executioner's Calling shuts down Defiant Dance and Sundered Sky healing, which is the only thing that lets her survive my extended on-hit DPS post-item.
edits.after: Bramble Vest or Executioner's Calling cuts the Bladesurge and Sundered Sky healing that is the only thing letting her survive my extended on-hit DPS post-item.

edits.before: Defiant Dance reduces and stores the damage you feed it, then heals her. Never burn Alpha Strike's burst while her W channel is active.
edits.after: Defiant Dance takes reduced physical damage while she charges, and releases a bigger strike — never burn Alpha Strike's burst into that channel.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetable frames dodge her Flawless Duet blades and her Bladesurge engage. Her Defiant Dance eats Q's burst and heals — never feed it. Wuju Style's true damage ignores the armor her passive and items give her. Highlander resets chain kills once she's used Q-reset and E.
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetable frames dodge her Flawless Duet blades and her Bladesurge engage, but the stun cancels Meditate outright, so never channel with her E up. Wuju Style's true damage ignores the armour her items give her, and Highlander's slow immunity walks straight through the Vanguard's Edge wall.

edits.before: Your first attack-speed/lifesteal item wins prolonged fights against her.
edits.after: Your first on-hit item wins prolonged fights once anti-heal is up.

edits.before: Her spike stays ahead — with her level-6 power and Flawless Duet (E) stun she can burst you in a trade before your sustain matters, so don't force the all-in until her E is down.
edits.after: Her spike stays ahead — Flawless Duet (E) stuns you out of a trade and cancels Meditate mid-channel, so your sustain never lands; don't force the all-in until that 16s E is down.

edits.before: With attack speed and lifesteal you win prolonged fights; Irelia needs the Flawless Duet (E) stun to burst you, so bait it out and then all-in when it's down.
edits.after: With attack speed you win prolonged fights, but Bladesurge heals her every reset — bring Grievous Wounds, bait Flawless Duet, and all-in on its 16s.

notes: Defiant Dance was credited with a heal it does not have, which mattered because it was the stated justification for the anti-heal buy — the actual heal is Bladesurge, on every reset, so the buy is right for a different reason. Level chart untouched and consistent across both layers. Not asserted: the kit file carries a 'grounding' flag on Flawless Duet that Riot's own description does not support (the text gives damage, stun and Mark only), so I did not write any grounding claim into the page.
